cards.card_text: Meanwhile, Sheba passes through all the tribes of Israel, and the Berites gather together and follow him.
cards.verse_text: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
cards.snippet: …tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
